snippet.title: Spring Tales Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Spring Tales is a cozy 2D puzzle adventure game. Help the charming residents of Blossomdale prepare for their spring festival by solving puzzles, overcoming challenges, and rebuilding after a storm.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3194840/Spring_Tales/
